grades.reason: Directly lists ordered and unordered FCMP predicates, explains NaN-induced unordered outcomes, and distinguishes quiet versus signaling QNaN exception behavior.
Contents entries for moves, branches, and memory operations do not explain FCMP conditions or NaN behavior.
Describes RISC-V half-precision comparisons, not the required LoongArch FCMP conditions.
Ordered and unordered refer to RISC-V vector memory operations, not LoongArch floating-point comparisons.
